shops.keeper: Sorsha (ancient) Fair and firm (no haggling)
shops.greeting: Oh dear, who fitted that for you? Come here, come here.
quirks: Tests shields by having customers hit them as hard as they can. Is never impressed.
Offers a free repair if you bring back a dented piece with a good story.
shops.rumour: [partly true] Simkin the tanner ordered child-sized armor. Twelve sets. Paid in advance.

shops.name: The Patient Shield
shops.keeper: Oona (young) Fair and firm (no haggling)
shops.greeting: Oh dear, who fitted that for you? Come here, come here.
quirks: Will not let a customer leave in badly fitted armor, even if they bought it elsewhere.
shops.rumour: [true] Somebody fished a breastplate out of the river with a hole punched right through it. From the inside.

shops.name: Thornhide Armory
shops.keeper: Dolla (middle-aged) Soft-hearted (−5% for a sad story)
shops.greeting: Welcome, little one. ...Yes, you're all little ones to me.
quirks: Talks to the armor stands as if they were old friends.
Has a pet tortoise named after a famous general.
shops.rumour: [true] The lord's guard came in for refitting. Every shield had the same claw marks.

shops.name: Mosswick Remedies
shops.keeper: Fenna (middle-aged) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: Welcome! Ignore the smoke, that's normal. Mostly normal.
quirks: Is missing an eyebrow. Do not ask about the eyebrow.
shops.rumour: [true] Nightcap mushrooms are fruiting early in the woods to the east. Bad sign.

shops.name: Mosswick & Mosswick, Apothecaries
shops.keeper: Mabry (young) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: Don't touch the blue one. Or, actually, go ahead, I need the data.
quirks: Offers a discount if you try an experimental potion. Results vary.
Gets distracted mid-sentence by a new idea and scribbles it down.
shops.rumour: [false] Someone ordered enough sleeping draught to fell a giant. Paid in very old coins.

shops.name: The Bubbling Cauldron
shops.keeper: Orryn (older) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: Ah! You look tired. And injured. And slightly cursed? Let me see...
quirks: Keeps a frog familiar that "tastes-tests" ingredients.
shops.rumour: [false] There is a cough going round Eaglecrag. Not natural. Smells of copper.

shops.name: The Smoking Cauldron
shops.keeper: Wizzle (middle-aged) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: Welcome! Ignore the smoke, that's normal. Mostly normal.
quirks: Sends letters to the other Mosswicks comparing notes on customers.
shops.rumour: [true] I'll pay well for wraith parts. A colleague says one was seen near Kingseaglestow.

shops.name: The Seventh Key
shops.keeper: Vaelan (ancient) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: Ah. The bell did not ring, and yet here you are.
quirks: Wraps every item in black silk and a sprig of rosemary.
shops.rumour: [false] An heirloom of our house went missing a century ago. It has been seen again, near Kingswickcrag.

shops.name: Veyl Antiquities
shops.keeper: Myrael (ancient) Fair and firm (no haggling)
shops.greeting: Welcome. Please do not make eye contact with the mirror.
quirks: Sometimes asks for a memory, a secret or a favour instead of coin.
shops.rumour: [false] Lights have been seen on the peak where nobody has lived for a hundred years.

shops.name: House Veyl Curios
shops.keeper: Nyxa (young) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: Ah. The bell did not ring, and yet here you are.
quirks: Never seems to blink.
shops.rumour: [false] That avalanche at the pass was started on purpose. I heard the horn.

shops.name: Ysmae Veyl's Wonders
shops.keeper: Ysmae (middle-aged) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: You were expected. Well... someone was.
quirks: Has a raven that repeats the last thing a customer said.
Their shop is bigger on the inside, and they won't discuss it.
shops.rumour: [true] Joan the widow up the hill came in asking how to break a curse. They would not say whose.

shops.name: Pennywhistle & Kin Trading Post
shops.keeper: Dilly (young) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: Ooh, new faces! You look like folk who need rope. Everyone needs rope.
quirks: Has a "lucky" item they refuse to sell at any price.
shops.rumour: [false] Someone is leaving carved wooden dolls on doorsteps. They look like the people inside.

shops.name: Hearthscale Hall
shops.keeper: Uadjit (young) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: You look like you've walked a long road. First drink's on the Hearthscales.
quirks: Brews a secret family ale and will only say it contains "a bit of dragon".
Keeps a "trouble jar" of coins: anyone who starts a brawl pays into it.
shops.rumour: [true] There's a cellar under the old mill with a door that wasn't there last year.

shops.name: Pennywhistle's Sundries & Supplies
shops.keeper: Tamsin (middle-aged) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: Welcome, welcome! If we haven't got it, my cousin in the next town does.
quirks: Writes letters to every other Pennywhistle shop weekly and will happily pass messages along.
Has a "lucky" item they refuse to sell at any price.
shops.rumour: [false] The tax collector is a week late. Nobody's complaining, but everyone's nervous.

shops.name: Rurik Emberforge's Smithy
shops.keeper: Rurik (old) Fair and firm (no haggling)
shops.greeting: Hold it like you mean it, or don't hold it at all.
quirks: Tests every blade on a ham hanging from the ceiling.
shops.rumour: [true] The Thornhide folk say the shipments from Copperdelve have stopped coming.
